user_problem: Teams need observable escalation triggers rather than vague instructions such as escalate when serious.
unique_output: A catalog of trigger, threshold, evidence required, escalation destination, timing, and explicit non-trigger examples.
required_input: Escalation policy, measurable thresholds, named destinations, timing rules, and supplied boundary examples.
critical_rule: Do not define severity or thresholds not present in the policy; ambiguous cases remain policy gaps.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is approval-path-mapper; this operationalizes escalation conditions rather than approval sequences.
acceptance_scenario: Input says escalate to Lead when backlog exceeds 25 for two consecutive checks; one check at 27 is insufficient. Output states the two-check trigger and lists 27 then 24 as a non-trigger.
